text: Mobile app development is an exciting field with many important decisions. One key choice is between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for one operating system, which often gives better performance. Cross-platform apps work on several systems at once and can save time and money. Responsive design is also essential, because users expect apps to look good on different screen sizes. After development, most apps are published through app stores like Google Play or the App Store. However, performance must always be tested carefully, since slow or crashing apps quickly lose users. Good planning helps developers create apps that are fast, reliable, and enjoyable to use.
